           reject(new Error('Upload cancelled'))\n                  return\n                }\n                try {\n                  this.sftpHandle.close(handle)\n                } catch (closeErr) {\n                  // 忽略关闭错误\n                }\n                reject(err)\n                return\n              }\n\n              position += chunk.length\n              uploadedBytes += chunk.length\n\n              // ── 每次 chunk 写入远程后：触发进度回调 ───────────────────\n              // 计算逻辑同 download：瞬时速度 = 本轮增量字节 / 时间差\n              // 更新时间戳和已传字节数，供下一轮计算使用\n              if (onProgress && fileSize > 0) {\n                const speed = this.calculateTransferSpeed(\n                  uploadedBytes,\n                  lastUpdateTime,\n                  lastUploadedBytes\n                )\n                \n                lastUpdateTime = Date.now()\n                lastUploadedBytes = uploadedBytes\n                \n                onProgress(speed, uploadedBytes, taskId, node)\n              }\n            })\n          })\n\n          readStream.on('end', () => {\n            try {\n              this.sftpHandle.close(handle)\n            } catch (closeErr) {\n              // 忽略关闭错误\n            }\n            // ── 文件上传完成（readStream end 事件）：触发最后一次进度回调 ──\n            // 需要在此处补发的原因：\n            //   1. 空文件（0 字节）不会触发 data 事件，进度回调永远不会执行\n            //   2. 非空文件最后一个 chunk 的 write 回调可能滞后于 end 事件\n            //      导致最后一次进度丢失，前端进度条卡在 99%\n            if (onProgress) {\n              const speed = this.calculateTransferSpeed(\n                uploadedBytes,\n                lastUpdateTime,\n                lastUploadedBytes\n              )\n              onProgress(speed, uploadedBytes, taskId, node)\n            }\n            resolve()\n          })\n\n          readStream.on('error', (err) => {\n            try {\n              this.sftpHandle.close(handle)\n            } catch (closeErr) {\n              // 忽略关闭错误\n            }\n            reject(err)\n          })\n        })\n      })\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件夹（递归）\n   */\n  async uploadFolder(\n    taskId: string,\n    node: TransferNode,\n    onProgress?: (speed: number, transferredBytes: number, taskId: string, node: TransferNode) => void\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.sftpHandle) {\n      throw new Error('SFTP not connected')\n    }\n\n    const remotePath = node.remotePath!\n\n    try {\n      await this.mkdir(remotePath)\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      throw error\n    }\n\n    await this.uploadDirectoryRecursive(taskId, node, onProgress)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 递归上传目录\n   */\n  private async uploadDirectoryRecursive(\n    taskId: string,\n    node: TransferNode,\n    onProgress?: (speed: number, transferredBytes: number, taskId: string, childNode: TransferNode) => void\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.uploadCancelled) {\n      throw new Error('Upload cancelled')\n    }\n\n    const remoteDir = node.remotePath!\n\n    try {\n      await this.mkdir(remoteDir)\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      throw error\n    }\n\n    if (!node.children || node.children.length === 0) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    for (const child of node.children) {\n      if (this.uploadCancelled) {\n        throw new Error('Upload cancelled')\n      }\n\n      if (child.isDirectory) {\n        await this.uploadDirectoryRecursive(taskId, child, onProgress)\n      } else {\n        await this.uploadFile(taskId, child, onProgress)\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建目录\n   */\n  async mkdir(remotePath: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.sftpHandle) {\n      throw new Error('SFTP not connected')\n    }\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      // 尝试创建目录，如果已存在则忽略错误\n      this.sftpHandle.mkdir(remotePath, { mode: 0o755 }, (err: Error) => {\n        if (err) {\n          // 如果错误是因为目录已存在，则忽略\n          if (err.message.includes('Failure') || err.message.includes('already exists')) {\n            // 检查目录是否存在\n            this.sftpHandle.stat(remotePath, (statErr: Error) => {\n              if (statErr) {\n                reject(err)\n              } else {\n                resolve()\n              }\n            })\n          } else {\n            reject(err)\n          }\n        } else {\n          resolve()\n        }\n      })\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除远程文件或目录（递归）\n   * \n   * 设计对齐 uploadFile/downloadFile 模式：\n   *   - 接收 TransferNode 而非 remotePath 字符串\n   *   - 回调签名统一为 (speed, transferredBytes, taskId, node)\n   *   - 文件：删除前 0%，删除完成 100%\n   *   - 目录：删除前 0%，递归删完子项后 100%\n   */\n  async deleteFile(\n    taskId: string,\n    node: TransferNode,\n    onProgress?: (speed: number, transferredBytes: number, taskId: string, childNode: TransferNode) => void\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.sftpHandle) {\n      throw new Error('SFTP not connected')\n    }\n\n    const remotePath = node.remotePath!\n\n    // ── 删除开始：上报 0% 进度 ─────────────────────────────────────\n    if (onProgress) {\n      onProgress(0, 0, taskId, node)\n    }\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      this.sftpHandle.stat(remotePath, (err: Error, stats: any) => {\n        if (err) {\n          console.error('SFTPService.deleteFile stat 失败:', { remotePath, error: err.message })\n          reject(err)\n          return\n        }\n\n        if (stats.isDirectory()) {\n          // ── 目录：递归删除子项，完成后上报 100% ───────────────────\n          this.sftpHandle.readdir(remotePath, async (err: Error, entries: any[]) => {\n            if (err) {\n              console.error('SFTPService.deleteFile readdir 失败:', { remotePath, error: err.message })\n              reject(err)\n              return\n            }\n\n            // 删除所有子文件和子目录（通过 node.children 匹配子节点）\n            for (const entry of entries) {\n              if (entry.filename === '.' || entry.filename === '..') {\n                continue\n              }\n              const childPath = path.posix.join(remotePath, entry.filename)\n\n              // 从 node.children 中查找匹配的子节点\n              const childNode = node.children?.find(c => c.remotePath === childPath)\n              if (childNode) {\n                try {\n                  await this.deleteFile(taskId, childNode, onProgress)\n                } }\n              } else {\n                // 子节点不在 TransferNode 树中（异常情况），回退到路径删除\n                try {\n                  await this.deleteFileByPath(taskId, childPath, node, onProgress)\n                } catch (error: any) {\n                  console.error('SFTPService.deleteFile 删除子项失败(回退):', { childPath, error: error.message })\n                  reject(error)\n                  return\n                }\n              }\n            }\n\n            // ── 所有子项删除完毕：rmdir 空目录 + 上报 100% ─────────────\n            this.sftpHandle.rmdir(remotePath, (err: Error) => {\n              if (err) {\n                console.error('SFTPService.deleteFile rmdir 失败:', { remotePath, error: err.message })\n                reject(err)\n              } else {\n                console.log('SFTPService.deleteFile 目录删除成功:', { remotePath})\n                if (onProgress) {\n                  onProgress(0, node.size || 0, taskId, node)\n                }\n                resolve()\n              }\n            })\n          })\n        } else {\n          // ── 文件：unlink + 上报 100% ────────────────────────────────\n          this.sftpHandle.unlink(remotePath, (err: Error) => {\n            if (err) {\n              console.error('SFTPService.deleteFile unlink 失败:', { remotePath, error: err.message })\n              reject(err)\n            } else {\n              console.log('SFTPService.deleteFile 文件删除成功:', { remotePath})\n              if (onProgress) {\n                onProgress(0, node.size || 0, taskId, node)\n              }\n              resolve()\n            }\n          })\n        }\n      })\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 回退方法：当子节点不在 TransferNode 树中时，用路径方式删除\n   * 仅在 deleteFile 内部调用，保持对外 API 统一\n   */\n  private async deleteFileByPath(\n    taskId: string,\n    remotePath: string,\n    parentNode: TransferNode,\n    onProgress?: (speed: number, transferredBytes: number, taskId: string, childNode: TransferNode) => void\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.sftpHandle) {\n      throw new Error('SFTP not connected')\n    }\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      this.sftpHandle.stat(remotePath, (err: Error, stats: any) => {\n        if (err) {\n          reject(err)\n          return\n        }\n\n        if (stats.isDirectory()) {\n          this.sftpHandle.readdir(remotePath, async (err: Error, entries: any[]) => {\n            if (err) { reject(err); return }\n\n            for (const entry of entries) {\n              if (entry.filename === '.' || entry.filename === '..') continue\n              const childPath = path.posix.join(remotePath, entry.filename)\n              await this.deleteFileByPath(taskId, childPath, parentNode, onProgress)\n            }\n\n            this.sftpHandle.rmdir(remotePath, (err: Error) => {\n              if (err) { reject(err) } else { resolve() }\n            })\n          })\n        } else {\n          this.sftpHandle.unlink(remotePath, (err: Error) => {\n            if (err) { reject(err) } else { resolve() }\n          })\n        }\n      })\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 断开连接\n   */\n  disconnect(): void {\n    if (this.connected) {\n      this.client.end()\n      this.connected = false\n      this.sftpHandle = null\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ==================== v5 优化：文件树扫描方法 ====================\n\n  /** Windows 系统受保护目录列表（扫描时自动跳过） */\n  private static readonly SYSTEM_PROTECTED_DIRS: string[] = [\n    'System Volume Information',\n    '$Recycle.Bin',\n    '$RECYCLE.BIN',\n    'Recovery',\n    'Config.Msi'\n  ]\n\n  /**\n   * 扫描本地文件树（用于上传前的文件扫描）\n   * \n   * `node-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,\n          name: folderName,\n          isDirectory: false,\n          type: 'upload',\n          status: 'pending',\n          progress: 0,\n          size: stat.size,\n          localPath: normalizedFolderPath,\n          remotePath: path.posix.join(remoteBasePath, folderName),\n          speed: 0,\n          transferredBytes: 0\n        }\n        console.log(`[scanLocalTree] 单文件扫描完成: ${folderName}, 大小 ${stat.size} 字节`)\n        return { success: true, root: fileNode, totalFiles: 1, totalBytes: stat.size }\n      }\n\n      // 文件夹：创建根节点并递归扫描\n      const rootNode: TransferNode = {\n      id: `node-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,\n      name: folderName,\n      isDirectory: true,\n      type: 'upload',\n      status: 'pending',\n      progress: 0,\n      size: 0,\n      localPath: normalizedFolderPath,\n      remotePath: path.posix.join(remoteBasePath, folderName),\n      speed: 0,\n      transferredBytes: 0,\n      children: []\n    }\n\n    // 递归扫描函数（内部辅助函数）\n      async function scanDir(\n        currentPath: string,\n        currentNode: TransferNode,\n        currentRemotePath: string\n      ): Promise<{ files: number; bytes: number }> {\n        let files = 0\n        let bytes = 0\n\n        // 读取目录内容\n        const entries = await fs.promises.readdir(currentPath, { withFileTypes: true })\n\n        for (const entry of entries) {\n          // 跳过 . 和 .. 目录项\n          if (entry.name === '.' || entry.name === '..') {\n            continue\n          }\n\n          // 使用 path.join 拼接完整路径（屏蔽系统差异）\n          const fullPath = path.join(currentPath, entry.name)\n          const fullRemotePath = path.posix.join(currentRemotePath, console.warn(`[scanLocalTree] 跳过系统受保护目录: ${entry.name}`)\n              continue\n            }\n\n            try {\n              // 创建子目录节点（设置 parentId 建立父子关系）\n              const subNode:           currentNode.children?.push(subNode)\n\n            } catch (subError: any) {\n              console.warn(`[scanLocalTree] 无法访问子目录 ${fullPath}，已跳过:`, subError.message)\n\n              //                speed: 0,\n                transferredBytes: 0,\n                parentId: currentNode.id,\n                error: `无法访问: ${subError.message}`\n              }\n\n              currentNode.children?.push(errorNode)\n            }\n\n          } else if (entry.isFile()) {\n            try {\n              // 获取文件大小\n              const fileStat = await 9)}`,\n                name: entry.name,\n                isDirectory: false,\n                type: 'upload',\n                status: 'pending',\n                progress: 0,\n                size: parentId: currentNode.id\n              }\n\n              currentNode.children?.push(fileNode)\n\n              files++\n              bytes += fileStat.size\n\n            } catch (fileError: any) {\n              console.warn(`[scanLocalTree] 无法读取文件 ${fullPath}，已跳过:`, fileError.message)\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 更新当前节点的统计信息\n        currentNode.totalFiles = files\n        currentNode.size = bytes\n\n        return { files, bytes }\n      }\n\n      // 开始递归扫描\n      await scanDir(normalizedFolderPath, rootNode, rootNode.remotePath || '')\n\n      console.log(`[scanLocalTree] 扫描完成：${rootNode.totalFiles} 个文件，总大小 ${rootNode.size} 字节`)\n\n      return { success: true, root: rootNode, totalFiles: rootNode.totalFiles, totalBytes: rootNode.size }\n\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(`[scanLocalTree] 扫描失败: ${folderPath}`, error)\n      return { success: false, error: error.message }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 扫描远程文件树（用于下载/删除前的文件扫描）\n   * \n   * v5 优化：直接返回 TransferNode 对象（无循环引用，可安全通过 IPC 序列化）\n   * 远程路径统一使用 / 分隔符（SFTP 标准），本地路径使用 path.join 屏蔽系统差异\n   * 支持单文件和文件夹（含空目录）\n   * \n   * @param remotePath 要扫描的远程路径（文件或文件夹）\n   * @param boolean; root?: TransferNode; totalFiles?: number; totalBytes?: number; error?: string }> {\n    const remoteName = remotePath.split('/').pop() || remotePath\n\n    try {\n      // 验证 SFTP 连接状态\n      if (!this.sftpHandle) {\n        throw new Error('SFTP 未连接')\n      }\n\n      // 判断远程路径是文件还是目录（Promise 包装 callback 风格的 stat）\n      const stats = await new Promise<any>((resolve, reject) => {\n        this.sftpHandle!.stat(remotePath, (err: Error, s: any) => {\n          if (err) reject(err)\n          else resolve(s)\n        })\n      })\n\n      // 单文件：直接返回文件节点作为根\n      if 'download' : 'delete',\n      status: 'pending',\n      progress: 0,\n      size: 0,\n      localPath: localBasePath ? path.normalize(path.join(localBasePath, remoteName)) : '',\n      remotePath: remotePath,\n      speed: 0,\n      transferredBytes: 0,\n      children: []\n    }\n\n    // 递归扫描函数（内部辅助函数）\n      async function scanRemoteDir(\n        this: SFTPService,\n        currentRemotePath: string,\n        currentNode: TransferNode,\n        currentLocalBase: string\n      ): Promise<{ files: number; bytes: number }> {\n        let files = 0\n        let bytes = 0\n\n        // 列出远程目录内容（使用实例方法 listDir）\n        const entries = await this!.listDir(currentRemotePath)\n\n        for (const entry of entries) {\n          if (entry.name === '.' || entry.name === '..') {\n            continue\n          }\n\n          // 构建完整路径（远程使用 /，本地使用 path.join）\n          const fullRemotePath = `${currentRemotePath}/${entry.name}`\n          const fullLocalPath = path.normalize(path.join(currentLocalBase, entry.name))\n\n          if (entry.isDirectory) {\n            try {\n              // 创建子目录节点（设置 parentId）\n              const subNode: TransferNode = {\n                id: `node-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,\n                name: entry.name,\n                isDirectory: true,\n                type: localBasePath ? 'download' : 'delete',\n                status: 'error',\n                progress: 0,\n                size: 0,\n                localPath: fullLocalPath,\n                remotePath: fullRemotePath,\n                speed: 0,\n                transferredBytes: 0,\n                parentId: currentNode.id,\n                error: `无法访问目录: ${subError.message}`,\n                children: []\n              }\n\n              currentNode.children?.push(errorNode)\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 创建文件节点（设置 parentId）\n            const fileNode: TransferNode = {\n              id: `node-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,\n              name: entry.name,\n              isDirectory: false,\n              type: localBasePath ? 'download' : 'delete',\n              status: 'pending',\n              progress: 0,\n              size: entry.size || 0,\n              localPath: fullLocalPath,\n              remotePath: fullRemotePath,\n              speed: 0,\n              transferredBytes: 0,\n              parentId: currentNode.id\n            }\n\n            currentNode.children?.push(fileNode)\n\n            files++\n            bytes += entry.size || 0\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 更新当前节点的统计信息\n        currentNode.totalFiles = files\n        currentNode.size = bytes\n\n        return { files, boundScanRemoteDir = scanRemoteDir.bind(this)\n      await boundScanRemoteDir(remotePath, rootNode, rootNode.localPath || '')\n\n      console.log(`[scanRemoteTree] 扫描完成：${rootNode.totalFiles} 个文件，总大小 ${rootNode.size} 字节`)\n\n      return { success: true, root: rootNode, totalFiles: rootNode.totalFiles, totalBytes: rootNode.size }\n\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(`[scanRemoteTree] 扫描失败: ${remotePath}`, error)\n      return { success: false, error: error.message }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * SFTP 连接池（单例模式）\n */\nclass SFTPConnectionPool {\n  private static instance: SFTPConnectionPool\n  private connections: Map<string, SFTPService> = new Map()\n\n  private constructor() {}\n\n  static getInstance(): SFTPConnectionPool {\n    if (!SFTPConnectionPool.instance) {\n      SFTPConnectionPool.instance = new SFTPConnectionPool()\n    }\n    return SFTPConnectionPool.instance\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取或创建 SFTP 连接\n   */\n  getConnection(sessionId: string): SFTPService {\n    if (!this.connections.has(sessionId)) {\n      const service = new SFTPService()\n      this.connections.set(sessionId, service)\n    }\n    return this.connections.get(sessionId)!\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 移除连接\n   */\n  removeConnection(sessionId: string): void {\n    const connection = this.connections.get(sessionId)\n    if (connection) {\n      connection.disconnect()\n Math.round((data.transferredBytes / node.size) * 100) : (data.transferredBytes > 0 ? 100 : 0)\n\n      console.log(`[delete] 进度回调: ${node.name} | progress=${progress}%`)\n\n      // 首次收到进度回调时初始化 startTime（文件和目录统一）\n      const liveNode = sftpTransferStore.getNode(taskId, node.id)\n      const updates: Partial<TransferNode> = { progress, speed: data.speed, transferredBytes: data.transferredBytes }\n      if (liveNode && !liveNode.startTime) {\n        updates.startTime = Date.now()\n      }\n\n      sftpTransferStore.mutateNode(taskId, node.id, updates)\n\n      // 标记当前活跃传输节点（用于 UI 高亮定位）\n      sftpTransferStore.updateTask(taskId, { activeNodeId: node.id })\n    }\n  })\n  \n  try {\n    if (!node.remotePath) {\n      throw new Error('远程路径为空')\n    }\n    \n    // 调用 Electron API 删除文件/目录（对齐 upload/download 签名：connectionId + taskId + node）\n    const result = await window.api.sftp.delete(sftpConnectionId, taskId, node)\n    \n    if (!result.success) {\n      throw new Error(result.error || '删除失败')\n    }\n    \n    // 删除完成 - 更新最终状态\n    sftpTransferStore.mutateNode(taskId, node.id, {\n      status: 'completed',\n      progress: 100,\n      speed: 0,\n      transferredBytes: node.size || 0,\n      endTime: Date.now()\n    })\n    console.log(`[delete] ✅ 删除完成: ${node.name}`)\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error(`[delete] ❌ 删除失败: ${node.name}`, * \n * @param node 当前节点（文件夹或文件）\n * @param sftpConnectionId SFTP 连接标识符（已在 TerminalTab 初始化时建立）\n * @param taskId 任务 ID（用于 Store 更新）\n */\nexport async function deleteFolderContent(\n  node:  await deleteFolderContent(child, sftpConnectionId, taskId)\n    }\n    // 所有子项删除完成 - 最后删除父文件夹本身（传递 sftpConnectionId）\n    await deleteSingleItem(node, sftpConnectionId, taskId)\n    \n  } else if (node.isDirectory) {\n    // 空目录或无子节点信息的目录 - 直接删除目录本身（传递 sftpConnectionId）\n    console.log(`[delete] 检测到空目录/叶子目录，直接删除: ${node.name}`)\n    await deleteSingleItem(node, sftpConnectionId, taskId)\n    \n  } else if (!node.isDirectory) {\n    // 如果是文件，执行删除（传递 sftpConnectionId）\n    await deleteSingleItem(node, sftpConnectionId, taskId)\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 批量删除本地文件/文件夹（支持混合选择）\n * \n * ✅ 新架构：每个选中的文件/文件夹创建独立的 TransferTask\n * - 选择 N 个项目 → 创建 N 个 TransferTask\n * - 每个任务独立管理进度、状态、取消操作\n * - 符合用户期望的\"多任务\"模式（与 uploadBatch/downloadBatch 对称）\n * \n * @param paths - 本地文件/文件夹路径数组\n * @param    try {\n      // 调用主进程接口获取文件名（使用 Node.js path.basename，屏蔽系统差异）\n      const fileNameResult = await window.api.sftp.basename(filePath)\n      const fileName = fileNameResult.data || filePath\n      \n      // 先创建任务（root 暂时为 undefined）\n      const task = createTransferTask({\n        type: 'delete',\n        sftpConnectionId: sftpConnectionId\n      })\n\n      sftpTransferStore.addTask(task)\n      createdTasks.push(task)\n\n      // 统一使用扫描 API（支持单文件和文件夹）\n      // 本地删除不需要 remoteBasePath，传空字符串\n      console.log(`[delete-local] 扫描本地路径: ${filePath}`)\n      \n      try {\n        const     }\n        \n        const ipcRoot = delScanResult.root as TransferNode\n        task.root = ipcRoot\n        task.totalBytes = delScanResult.totalBytes || 0\n\n      sftpTransferStore.updateTaskStatus(task.id, 'error')\n        task.status = 'error'\n      }\n      \n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(`[delete-local] 处理本地路径失败: ${filePath}`, sftpTransferStore.updateTaskStatus(task.id, 'transferring')\n      sftpTransferStore.mutateNode(task.id, task.root!.id, {\n        status: 'transferring',\n        startTime: Date.now()\n      })\n      \n      if (!task.root!.localPath) {\n        throw new Error('本地路径为空，无法删除')\n      }\n\n      // 监听本地删除进度（对齐 upload/download 进度事件格式，按 nodeId 精确匹配）\n      const cleanupProgress = ${successCount}, 失败: ${failCount}, 总计: ${createdTasks.length}`)\n  \n  return { success: successCount, failed: failCount }\n}\n\n/**\n * 批量删除远程文件/文件夹（支持混合选择）\n * \n * ✅ 新架构：每个选中的文件/文件夹创建独立的 判断是文件还是文件夹（通过查询远程路径类型）\n      const listResult = await window.api.sftp.listDir(\n        sftpConnectionId, \n        remotePath.includes('/') ? remotePath.substring(0, remotePath.lastIndexOf('/')) : ${createdTasks.length} 个远程删除任务`)\n  \n  for (let i = 0; i < createdTasks.length; i++) {\n    const task = createdTasks[i]\n    \n    console.log(`[delete-remote] 开始删除任务 ${i + function uploadFile(\n  filePath: string,\n  sftpConnectionId: string,\n  sessionId?: string,\n  remotePath?: string | { value: string }\n): Promise<void> {\n  const sftpTransferStore = useSftpTransferStore()\n  \n  console.log('[upload] 开始上传文件:', filePath, '连接ID:', sftpConnectionId)\n  \n  if (!sftpConnectionId) {\n    throw new Error('SFTP 连接标识符不能为空（连接未建立）')\n  }\n  \n  if (!filePath) {\n    throw new Error('文件路径不能为空')\n  }\n  \n  try {\n    const remoteBasePath = typeof remotePath === 'string' \n      ? remotePath \n      : (remotePath?.value || '/')\n    \n    \n sftpTransferStore.addTask(task)\n    \n    // 统一使用扫描 API（支持单文件和文件夹，返回完整 TransferNode 树）\n    console.log(`[upload] 扫描本地路径: ${filePath}`)\n    const scanResult = await sftpTransferStore.initNodeIndex(task.id)\n\n    // 扫描完成，任务进入传输阶段\n    sftpTransferStore.updateTaskStatus(task.id, 'transferring')\n\n    // 更新根节点状态为传输中\n    sftpTransferStore.mutateNode(task.id, async function uploadBatch(\n  paths: string[],\n  sftpConnectionId: string,\n  sessionId?: string,\n  remotePath?: string | { value: string }\n): Promise<void> {\n  const sftpTransferStore = 连接标识符不能为空（连接未建立）')\n  }\n  \n  if (!paths || paths.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error('上传路径列表不能为空')\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const remoteBasePath = typeof remotePath === 'string' \n      ? remotePath \n  }\n        \n        const entry = dirResult.data.find((item: any) => item.name === fileName)\n        \n        if (!entry) {\n          console.warn(`[upload] 在父目录中未找到: ${fileName}`)\n          continue\n        }\n        \n        const isDirectory = entry.isDirectory\n        \n        if (isDirectory) {\n          console.log(`[upload] 创建文件夹上传任务: ${filePath}`)\n\n          // 先创建         status: 'pending'\n            }\n          })\n\n          sftpTransferStore.addTask(task)\n          createdTasks.push(task)\n\n          console.log(`[upload] ✅ 已创建上传任务 #${createdTasks.length}（扫描中）: ${fileName}`)\n\n          try {\n            console.log(`[upload] 扫描文件夹（主进程扫描）: ${filePath}`)\n            \n            // 设置任务状态为\"扫描中\"，UI 可显示进度提示\n            sftpTransferStore.updateTaskStatus(task.id, 'scanning')\n            \n            // 调用主进程扫描 API（一次性返回完整树结构）\n            const batchScanResult = await window.api.sftp.scanLocalTree(filePath, 扫描完成后检查是否已被用户取消（避免取消后仍进入传输阶段）\n            if (sftpTransferStore.getTask(task.id)?.status === 'cancelled') {\n              console.log(`[upload] 批量上传任务已被用户取消，跳过传输: ${fileName}`)\n
